summary:
USER_CONTEXT: Fix dotenv parsing so that an empty unquoted value followed by whitespace and an inline comment (e.g. `KEY= # explanation`) parses as the empty string. Hash characters without preceding whitespace (`KEY=#literal`, `KEY=a#b`) must remain literal. Preserve quoting, exports, and ordinary comments. Only edit `src/dotenv/parser.py`; do not modify tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies. Finish once implementation is ready.

TASK_TRACKING: Task ID: r3-empty_inline_comment — Status: IN_PROGRESS (implementation being applied to parser.py)

COMPLETED:
- Read TASK.md, README.md, main.py, parser.py, test_parser.py
- Diagnosed root cause: `_equal_sign` regex (`=[^\S\r\n]*`) consumes whitespace after `=`, so `parse_unquoted_value`'s strip regex `\s+#.*` fails to match `# explanation` (no preceding whitespace), yielding `"# explanation"` instead of `""`
- First edit attempt: changed strip regex to `(?:^|\s+)#.*` — identified this breaks `KEY=#literal` (would incorrectly strip to `""`)
- Second edit: changed `_equal_sign` to not consume trailing whitespace so `parse_unquoted_value` can distinguish `KEY= #c` (space before `#`) from `KEY=#c` (no space)

PENDING:
- Verify final logic against all required cases (`KEY= # explanation` → `""`, `KEY=#literal` → `"#literal"`, `KEY=a#b` → `"a#b"`)
- Confirm no regressions in quoting/exports/ordinary comments
- Finish task

CURRENT_STATE: Working file: `src/dotenv/parser.py`. Key functions: `parse_unquoted_value` (lines ~123-125), `parse_binding` (uses `_equal_sign` at ~line 157). Regexes: `_equal_sign`, `_unquoted_value` (`([^\r\n]*)`), `_whitespace` (`[^\S\r\n]*`).

CODE_STATE:
- File: `src/dotenv/parser.py`
- `parse_unquoted_value(reader)` — strip regex modified
- `_equal_sign` regex — modified to not consume trailing whitespace
- `parse_binding` — only consumer of `_equal_sign`

CHANGES:
- Edit 1: `parse_unquoted_value` strip regex changed to `(?:^|\s+)#.*` (reverted/revised due to `KEY=#literal` regression)
- Edit 2: `_equal_sign` changed to stop consuming trailing whitespace, leaving leading space in value part for correct comment detection

TESTS: Not yet run. Expected cases: `KEY= # explanation` → `""`; `KEY=#literal` → `"#literal"`; `KEY=a#b` → `"a#b"`.

DEPS: None modified (only parser.py edited per constraint)

VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS: Not tracked in events.
